pageCache.pageTitle: Late/Absence Procedures | Milton Court Primary Academy
pageCache.text:
Late/Absence Procedures
In line with the the school's absence procedure, when your child is absent from school a call should be made to the school as early as possible using the absence line.
The school number is 01795 472972 and has a dedicated absence line (option 1).
Please call as early as possible before your child's registration time.
If you fail to report your childs absence, in line with our attendance policy, it will be classed as unauthorised absence and dealt with via the KCC PIAS (PRU, Inclusion and Attendance Service) which could result in a penalty notice.

pageCache.pageTitle: What your child should be able to do before starting school | Milton Court Primary Academy
pageCache.text:
What your child should be able to do before starting school
Getting your child ready for Reception!
Here are a list of challenges for your child to practise over the summer so they are ready for school!
- take turns in a game
- recognise their name
- ask for help if needed
- listen to a story that is read to them and answer simple questions about what they have heard.
- use a knife, fork and spoon independently
- put on and take off their cardigan/jumper and coat
- attend to own toileting and wash hands
- count up to ten objects by touching each one.
Please keep an eye on this page for future challenges.
Over the summer, we will set a challenge each week and ask you to put photos/observations onto dojo to show they have met the challenge.

pageCache.pageTitle: About our nursery | Milton Court Primary Academy
pageCache.text:
About our nursery
Our Nursery
About our nursery
Milton Court Primary Academy EYFS - REAch2 Academy Trust
Want to know more about our school or to organise a visit to come and see us? head over to our website https://www.milton-court.kent.sch.uk/
Milton Court Nursery, part of Milton Court Primary Academy, is a purpose-designed, spacious Nursery consisting of two rooms with kitchen and toilet facilities and an outside area exclusively for the use of children in the Early Years. Our Pre-School room is for children in the year before they move to Reception Class. Our Nursery room is for the younger children.
Our well trained, enthusiastic and experienced staff team will ensure your child has the opportunity to participate in a range of stimulating and engaging learning experiences that are planned around the children's needs and interests. The Nursery is overseen by a qualified teacher.
Our aim is to provide a warm, happy and fun learning environment where the children can develop at their own pace with guidance and encouragement from our staff. We provide different learning experiences through different areas of play in our Nursery which allows the children to explore through child-initiated play and adult-led play. The children are encouraged to become independent, confident and responsible.
The children have access to the outside learning area at all times. A recent addition of a new canopy allows the children to enjoy outdoor facilities all year round, whatever the weather.
We understand the importance of working in partnership with our parents to ensure the children get the best start to their education. At Milton Court we use ‘Tapestry’ which is an easy-to-use and secure online learning journal helping Nursery staff and families celebrate each child's learning and development. Tapestry builds a very special record of a child's experiences, development and learning journey through their early years.
We prepare the children for their Reception year at school, giving them the opportunity to access a variety of resources and facilities and to be involved in the main life of the school.
Registration is free and no deposit is required.
